title: checkbox vs switch
name: Checkbox vs switch
rule: Checkbox often with a submit for state; a single checkbox can be two-state. Switch takes effect immediately and does not need a button. Dual-cite Lightning toggle-immediate; Ant names Switch vs checkbox pairing.
pass_when: Switch applies immediately with no submit. Checkbox state waits for submit when it is part of a submitted form; a single checkbox may be two-state.
fail_when: Switch that does nothing until a separate submit; or a form checkbox that applies immediately as if it were Switch.
overview: Switches apply immediately; checkboxes in forms wait for submit.
apply_when: Choosing between Switch and checkbox for a boolean on Ant surfaces.
not_when: Non-boolean inputs or controls outside Switch/checkbox pairing.
agent_hint: Use Switch for immediate toggles; keep form checkboxes until submit.
description: On Ant-style data entry, a Switch takes effect immediately and needs no submit button. A checkbox that is part of a submitted form waits for submit; a single checkbox may still be two-state. A Switch that does nothing until submit, or a form checkbox that applies instantly like a Switch, mixes the patterns. Pick based on whether change is immediate or form-bound.
do_not_claim: A house "all toggles immediate" beyond the two cites. A global immediate-vs-submit winner.
